steps.name: Install pinned YAML parser
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/lock-tools"
curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL --retry 3 https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/v4.54.1/yq_linux_amd64 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/lock-tools/yq"
echo "8e34fc298390875de416e6a4afcb8cabeceb25d9aa8506c1a2f9353cf702ea5f  $RUNNER_TEMP/lock-tools/yq" | sha256sum --check
chmod u+x "$RUNNER_TEMP/lock-tools/yq"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/lock-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Install test dependencies
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ripgrep ruby ruby-minitest

steps.name: Install gh-actions-lock
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl -sSfL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 3 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh-actions-lock" https://github.com/github/gh-actions-lock/releases/download/v0.2.0/linux-amd64
echo "79ec84c191667fd935a277e6fd3662cf5d3669cccc9e99998731d8f306f373b6  $RUNNER_TEMP/gh-actions-lock" | sha256sum --check
chmod u+x "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh-actions-lock"
echo "GH_ACTIONS_LOCK_BIN=$RUNNER_TEMP/gh-actions-lock" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: awk-dependent gates also run under mawk
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v mawk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update -qq
  sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends mawk
fi
shim="$RUNNER_TEMP/awk-shim"
mkdir -p "$shim"
ln -sf "$(command -v mawk)" "$shim/awk"
echo "awk -> $(PATH="$shim:$PATH" awk -W version 2>&1 | head -1)"
PATH="$shim:$PATH" bash scripts/tests/check-lock-sync-test.sh
PATH="$shim:$PATH" bash scripts/tests/uuid-v8-pragma-test.sh
